:::{.theorem data-title="Scheffe's Theorem"}

If $f_{n}\to f_{\infty}$ a.e. and if $\mu_{n}$ are, corresponding to $f_{n}$,
the measures
$$
\mu_{n}(B):= \int_{B}f_{n}(x)dx
$$
for all [[borel-sigma-algebra|Borel]] sets $B \in \mathcal{B}(\mathbb{R})$,
then
$$
\lVert \mu_{n}-\mu_{\infty} \rVert := \sup_{B\in \mathcal{B}}\lvert \mu_{n}(B)-\mu_{\infty}(B) \rvert \stackrel{n \to \infty}{\to} 0 .
$$

:::

`\begin{proof}`

`\end{proof}`
